# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **DO NOT** report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, discussions, or pull requests.

Use **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting (PVR)** instead:

1. Open the [Security tab](https://github.com/coucya/mcp-server-requests/security).
2. Click **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Fill in the report form.

Direct link: https://github.com/coucya/mcp-server-requests/security/advisories/new

Please include:

- Affected version(s)
- A description of the issue and its impact
- Steps to reproduce, or a minimal proof of concept
- Any suggested fix or mitigation, if you have one

## What to Expect

- I will investigate and keep you updated on the fix.
- I will credit you in the security advisory unless you prefer to remain anonymous.
- Please keep the details private until a fix is released and the advisory is published.
